newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates rise on mill owners' buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates rise on mill owners' buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates jumped on Thursday on select buying by mill owners and could remain stable in the coming days as arrival of fine-quality cotton from the 1997/98 (July-June) crop may be delayed, dealers said.

"Mill owners are going for the old cotton stocks because the new crop has not matured yet," dealer Nasim Usman said. "Cotton rates will remain at these levels because there is demand from mill owners."
He said there were still around 200,000 bales of unsold cotton available from the 1996/97 crop.
